comment: Juan is a great guy and has answers for any questions you have. The grading is somewhat harsh sometimes, and the lectures will be boring if you have no interest.
Extremely nice prof, just a lot of reading outside of class and grading can be unpredictable but other than that I recommend the class especially because prof Ardila is just such a nice guy.
Essays were very hard to get above an A, grading criteria was unclear. Very lecture heavy. Nice guy but painful class

If history doesn't interest you, the class will be boring because he lectures off the top of his head for most of the class. However, he is nice and personable. He is somewhat tough on the essays, but not too bad. There is a participation grade, however, the class is not very discussion based and most participation is answering questions aloud.

So much reading, and he is also a tough grader on essays. There isn't much contributing to your grade outside of the 3 papers. Overall the class was fine. Sometimes the material was really interesting but other times lectures would seemingly go forever. Not the hardest class ever, if you struggle with papers go to office hours.

He is one of the nicest professors and he cares about his students. There a lot of readings for homeowrk in this class but as long as you know the basics you should be good. Most of the class grade comes from essays (3 essays and one final paper). He's a very fair grader and he's really useful to meet with for these papers. Highly recommend!

Super caring professor. There is a lot of reading assigned for class. However, if you skim the readings and make AI summaries you should be able to participate in discussions. There are 3 papers and the final paper. Grading on the papers is fair but hard to get a high A.
Great professor and a really easy class if you need to take a history gen ed
I love this professor! He is very kind and helpful when giving feedback on papers. He is very accessible outside of the classroom and genuinely is passionate about his classes!

Great guy. Class is made up of 4 4-5 page papers and a final paper that was up to 12 pages. Good lecturer and the readings were reasonable in length for a history class. Would definitely take again if I have the chance.

Dr. Ardila Falla was very passionate in his classes and his lectures were always interesting and always explained the readings. There were only 4 papers aside from the final and he was a very competent grader, providing good feedback on any areas you could benefit from working on. Definitely take this class if you can!

Dr. Ardila Falla provides students with a really interesting perspective on history. He helps students learn to analyze primary sources more. Expect to get called on randomly in class so make sure you did your readings. He gives very clear edits on essays and is a reasonable grader. He's also a nice guy overall!
